reason: A dynamic DeepSeek Harness web UI skin plugin that extracts colors from uploaded images, applies generated themes, and uses the image as an adjustable wallpaper.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端上传图片并自动生成明暗主题，同时将图片设置为可调透明度的界面壁纸。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web UI skin plugin that generates light and dark themes from uploaded images and applies them as adjustable-opacity wallpapers.

capabilities: Processes uploaded images for color extraction
Applies generated light and dark theme tokens to the web UI
Uses uploaded images as adjustable-opacity background wallpapers
Stores temporary skin state in the host process
